commitRole: commit that the annotated tag v1.2.3 points to (merge of PR #782)

verified.method: git ls-remote for the tag object, git cat-file to resolve it to a commit, shallow clone at the tag, then byte-for-byte diff of the cloned tree against the local snapshot

snapshotDigestAlgorithm: sha256 over each file, concatenated as <relative posix path>\0<sha256-of-file or 'link:<target>'>\0, paths sorted
